action: Offer month-to-month customers a reward (for example a price lock or one free month) for moving to a one-year contract.
target_rule: active customers on a month-to-month contract
reasons: Recommended: prevents the most expected churners (406) of all simulated solutions whose known cost does not exceed the revenue they protect.

action: Give internet customers who lack online security or tech support both services free for a trial period (for example three months).
target_rule: active internet customers without online security or without tech support
reasons: Not chosen: prevents fewer expected churners (244) than Contract-upgrade offer (406).

action: Encourage electronic-check payers to move to automatic bank-transfer or credit-card payment (for example with a small one-off bill credit).
target_rule: active customers who pay by electronic check
reasons: Not chosen: prevents fewer expected churners (71) than Contract-upgrade offer (406).

action: Give the customers with the highest monthly bills (top 25%) a 10% discount.
target_rule: active customers in the top 25% of monthly charges
reasons: Not chosen: its known cost exceeds the revenue it protects (net -5,171 a month).

action: Welcome calls, a set-up check and reviews after 3 and 6 months for customers in their first year.
target_rule: active customers with tenure of 12 months or less
reasons: Supporting action, not simulated: tenure cannot be changed by an action, so the model cannot estimate the effect.

action: Investigate fibre-optic quality and price (outages, speed, competitor offers) and fix the causes that are found.
reasons: Supporting action, not simulated: the action is an investigation; moving customers to DSL would not be a real solution.

action: A dedicated support line and simpler plans for senior customers.
